note: The tools that judge the image are inputs too, and are pinned the same way (IMG-02). Each archive is verified against this digest before it is unpacked; a publisher's checksum file, fetched from the same place as the archive, is not relied on. Changing a version is a reviewed pull request.

syft.purpose: Bill of materials from the built image (IMG-21)

trivy.purpose: Vulnerability gate on the image (IMG-25); dependency, secret, and build-definition scan of the source (IMG-34)

grype.purpose: Second, independent vulnerability gate on the bill of materials (IMG-25)

cosign.purpose: Keyless signature and attestations on the released digest, and their verification (IMG-21, IMG-22)

clamav.purpose: Malware scan of the inputs and the image, with signatures refreshed in the same run (IMG-28)
